metric_note: The package reports MAX XOR against the rest frame normalised by BODY pixels; R121's floors were MEAN change between CONSECUTIVE frames normalised by FRAME area. Both are legitimate and they are not interchangeable. The package's three published figures were reproduced to within 0.7% using its convention, so the numbers are not in dispute - only their basis.
scale_note: Packed at 0.58 rather than R117's 0.70.
